q1.explanationZh: 第二段说妈妈有了包子男孩以后很开心（happy）。“lonely”是她有包子之前的感觉。

evidence.quote: She is happy to have Bao, the dumpling boy.

q2.explanationZh: 第三段说包宝宝长成年轻人后，把女朋友带回了家。

evidence.quote: He brings his girlfriend home and wants to move out.

q3.explanationZh: 第三段说妈妈为了不让他离开，把他吃掉了。

evidence.quote: Trying to stop Bao from leaving, the mother eats him!

q4.explanationZh: 最后一段说妈妈醒来，儿子带着女朋友来看她，三个人一起包饺子。吃掉儿子只是一场梦。
q4.tipsZh: It was all a dream. 说明前面的情节是梦。

evidence.quote: He and his girlfriend join the mother in making dumplings.
